description: Order service batch job leaks DB connections by not closing cursors in the finally block. Slow leak exhausts the pool over 3 hours.

known_root_cause.description: Nightly batch reconciliation job opens cursors in a try block but the finally clause only closes the connection, not the cursor. Leaked cursors hold DB connections open indefinitely, exhausting the 20-connection pool over ~3 hours of accumulated batch runs.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: deploy-order-041 introduces cursor leak in batch reconciliation job — cursor.close() missing from finally block, exhausting 20-connection pool over 3 hours
